thread:
lina-marketing: Heads-up — noticed several inbound leads routed to unassigned queue this morning, looks like HS->SF handoff failing for leads with enrichment = pending. Anyone else seeing this? :slightly_frowning_face:
ash_sales: saw 3 in my queue, pinged SDRs but they timed out. Did we change the round-robin rule yesterday?
tom-growth: I tweaked the HubSpot workflow last night to add the 'enriched_company' check, might be blocking some mapping. Reverting now.
lina-marketing: here's the offending HS filter:
```IF contact.property(enriched_company) IS EMPTY THEN assign_to_queue ELSE trigger_workflow```
— that was meant to throttle pre-enrichment handoffs.
priya-ops: That filter is fine, but the webhook to Salesforce is timing out: hubspot-bot posted 10:41 webhook failure 504 for /api/handoff. Logs: ```{"status":504,"error":"upstream timeout","attempt":2}```
kevin-sre: we're seeing intermittent 504s from the dedicated handoff lambda in us-west2 during peak. Increasing concurrency helps but need root cause.
ash_sales: SLA-wise, what's our guaranteed handoff time? We promised 15m claim SLA for inbound leads in playbooks.
lina-marketing: yes, 15 minutes. But measured median is 22m last 24h. Need quick mitigation.
tom-growth: short-term proposal: enable a fallback round-robin that ignores enrichment if lead_age > 10m. Config snippet:
```hubspot.workflow.fallback = true;
if (lead.age_minutes > 10) assign.round_robin.ignore_enrichment = true;```
priya-ops: love that. I'll open an emergency config PR and annotate rollback criteria. Also will add alert: hs.handoff.latency > 15m for 10m
kevin-sre: I'll add a synthetic test that triggers handoff every 2m and watch latency; will reroute to dedicated fallback pool if 95p > 20s
lina-marketing: who will own the customer escalations? We have 4 accounts affected (Acme, BetaCorp, Gamma). Need comms.
ash_sales: I'll draft an outbound note and run it by legal. assigning to me.
tom-growth: rolling the fallback at 12:15 PT, will monitor and report back in this thread. :thumbsup:
hubspot-bot: webhook retry queued for 3 failed requests
lina-marketing: thanks all — please post post-rollout metrics here (handoff latency, % assigned, any dupes).
